_comment: Ninter build config. Tuned via the previewer (preview/index.html), then used by build.py. Spatial values are font units at 1000 upm.
_comment_inter_weights: Independent Inter weight per Noto (output) weight. Inter looks heavier than Noto at the same nominal weight, so map each Noto weight to a (usually lighter) Inter wght. Keys are the output/Noto weight; values are the Inter wght axis value (100-900, fractional OK). inter_weight_offset is added on top for any weight not in the map.
_comment_cjk: cjk_tighten = fraction (0..1) of Noto's palt proportional metrics baked into default advances: tightens kana & makes punctuation half-width while kanji stay full-width. cjk_tracking = extra uniform tightening (units) on every CJK glyph.
_comment_defer: Route CJK-context symbols (circled numbers ①②, Roman numerals, box/geometric shapes, and any oversized symbol Inter draws large) to Noto's full-width glyphs instead of Inter's oversized ones. Latin punctuation stays Inter.
_comment_variants: Build two families following the MS Gothic / MS PGothic convention: plain 'Ninter' = full-width (no tsume, cjk_tighten 0), 'Ninter P' = proportional/tightened (palt baked, cjk_tighten 1.0). Each variant overrides family + cjk_tighten.
